column1: THE COMPILED ENUM AND TOKEN VALUES
The live src/ast.h and src/lexer.h were COMPILED by the host C
compiler, and a probe printed the values the COMPILER assigned.
Enum values are therefore NOT inferred from names, NOT inferred
from ordinal positions, and NOT copied from a predecessor's note.
